title: identifier required links not footer dup
name: Identifier required links not footer dup — USWDS
rule: Identifier holds the required federal links — don’t duplicate them in the site footer. Parent agency (highest in the hierarchy), not the product logo. Multiple parents/logos in hierarchical order, highest first. Omit identifier logo if it duplicates the footer agency mark. Entire component; no deleted required links.
pass_when: Required links live in the identifier once (not also in the footer); parent agency is highest in hierarchy; product logo is not used as the identifier mark; required links are not deleted.
fail_when: Required links duplicated in the footer; product logo in the identifier; required links omitted.
overview: Required federal links live once in the identifier with the parent agency mark, not duplicated in the footer.
apply_when: Placing required agency links and logos in the USWDS identifier.
not_when: Product logos as the identifier mark, or required links omitted or footer-duplicated.
agent_hint: Put required links only in the identifier; use the highest parent agency, not the product logo.
description: USWDS puts required federal links in the identifier once—do not duplicate them in the site footer. Use the parent agency highest in the hierarchy, not the product logo; multiple parents appear in hierarchical order, highest first. Omit the identifier logo if it duplicates the footer agency mark. Keep the entire component; do not delete required links. Footer duplicates, product logos in the identifier, or omitted required links fail.
do_not_claim: Identifier darker-than-footer (next row) as this links rule; Canada GC signature as a merge.
